title: EASL: Abra Weavers to debut in Oct. 3 game in Cebu

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Abra Weavers take the biggest step in franchise history on Saturday, October 3, when they become the first Maharlika Pilipinas Basketball League (MPBL) team to play in the East Asia Super League (EASL), facing Hong Kong Eastern at 7 p.m. at the SM Seaside Cebu Arena. The game also marks the first professional basketball contest at the new Cebu arena. For Abra, the EASL debut comes just two years after entering the MPBL in 2024.
